The federal court will likely grant the employer's motion and remand to state court, because 28 U.S.C. § 1441(a) allows only defendants to remove, so the plaintiff's counsel's removal is invalid even though federal claims are pleaded and the removal was timely. The court may also award the employer fees and costs under § 1447(c) if the removal lacked an objectively reasonable basis, and the judge's hostility is no ground to keep the case. The team note's "retain" answers conflict with this, and I think they are wrong on the law.

CONFIDENCE: 90
